about: Shared brief cases. Each case edits evals/briefing-decisions/brief.md (edits replace the first match in order; cut keeps the text before a marker; append adds text; pad inserts that many x characters before the final </details>). rule is the first broken rule both validators must report, or null when both must accept. python_only cases are checked only by brief_check.py; lib/brief.ts must accept them. Read by tests/test_briefing_decisions.py and tests/mission-control.test.ts.
